description.en: Iowa is a landlocked state in the Upper Midwest region of the United States. It borders the Mississippi River to the east and the Missouri River and Big Sioux River to the west; Wisconsin to the northeast, Illinois to the east and southeast, Missouri to the south, Nebraska to the west, South Dakota to the northwest, and Minnesota to the north.
description.zh-CN: 愛荷華州是美國中西部的一個州。東北部接壤威斯康星州，東部和東南部接壤伊利諾州，南部接壤密蘇里州，西部接壤內布拉斯加州，南達科他州在其西北部，明尼蘇達州在其北部。
